text: Day 1 Louvre and Seine walk. Day 2 Versailles day trip. Day 3 Montmartre and Sacre-Coeur. Hostel stays, picnic lunches.
Five days in Kyoto: Fushimi Inari at dawn, Arashiyama bamboo, a tea ceremony, Nara deer park day trip, ryokan with kaiseki dinners.
Lisbon over 4 days: tram 28, Belem tower, Sintra palaces, fado night. Mid-range hotel in Alfama.
Cairo in 2 days: Giza pyramids and the Egyptian Museum, then Khan el-Khalili bazaar. Budget guesthouse.
Reykjavik base for 6 days: Golden Circle, Blue Lagoon, whale watching, glacier hike. Boutique hotel and rental 4x4.
Hanoi 7 days: Old Quarter food tour, Ha Long Bay overnight cruise, Ninh Binh bikes. Hostels and street food, about 40 dollars a day.
Rome 3 days: Colosseum, Vatican museums, Trastevere dinner. Three-star hotel near Termini.
Marrakech for 4 days: medina souks, Majorelle Garden, Atlas day trip, hammam. Riad with breakfast.
Dubai 5 days: Burj Khalifa top deck, desert safari, Palm Jumeirah beach club, five-star resort suite.
Tbilisi in 3 days: sulfur baths, Narikala fortress, Kazbegi day trip. Cheap guesthouse and khinkali lunches.
Lima 4 days: Miraflores cliffs, ceviche cooking class, Barranco art walk, Pachacamac ruins. Mid-range boutique hotel.
Bali 8 days: Ubud rice terraces, Nusa Penida day trip, Uluwatu temple at sunset, private villa with pool and driver.
